attempts.summary: Pinned curl to its installed version 8.17.0-r1 on node1 by constraining the /etc/apk/world entry from a bare "curl" to "curl=8.17.0-r1", proved the pin survives a real system update (56 other packages upgraded, curl untouched), and completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol (boot_id changed, curl version and pin verified intact post-restart).
